execute_sql.description: Run SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE queries against linkedin_hunter schema

arguments.query: SQL query string. Always prefix tables with linkedin_hunter. schema.

examples: SELECT * FROM linkedin_hunter.qualified_leads ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT full_name, work_email, icp_score FROM linkedin_hunter.qualified_leads WHERE icp_score >= 7;
UPDATE linkedin_hunter.qualified_leads SET outreach_status = 'sent' WHERE linkedin_url = 'https://...';

apply_migration.description: Run DDL (CREATE/ALTER/DROP). Name MUST be globally unique — use timestamps.

arguments.name: Unique migration name (e.g. add_column_20260305). NEVER reuse.
arguments.query: SQL DDL string. Always end with: NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';

examples: ALTER TABLE linkedin_hunter.qualified_leads ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS my_col TEXT DEFAULT ''; NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';

list_tables.description: List all tables with columns, types, and row counts in a schema.

response_parsing.note: execute_sql wraps results in XML tags. Parse with:
response_parsing.pattern: Unescape (\n → newline, \" → quote), then find first [ to last ] and JSON.parse

tables.qualified_leads: Final enriched leads — upsert on linkedin_url
tables.discovery_evaluations: ICP gate audit trail — upsert on linkedin_url
tables.raw_job_postings: Phase 1A raw jobs — upsert on job_url
tables.raw_social: Social post storage (not actively used post-cleanup)
